_doc: A/B of the cardinality-cliff checkpoint fixes on the 6-lane NVMe cluster (bench-multilane, one physical NVMe per shard, MULTILANE=1). All configs use --wal-shards 6 (6 lanes). Compares: baseline (synchronized checkpoint wave = current), stagger (--wal-checkpoint-stagger on: round-robin per-shard checkpoints so only one device storms at a time), syncfs (--wal-checkpoint-syncfs on: one syncfs barrier per shard-device instead of O(N) per-stream fdatasync), and both. The baseline arm is also the s6@100k point the shard sweep was heading toward. Hypothesis: baseline stays ~10-11k at 100k (all lanes stall together); stagger and/or syncfs recover throughput by de-conflicting or shrinking the checkpoint storm. Requires MULTILANE=1 SERVER_LOCAL_SSD_BLOCK=1 SPOT_SERVER=1.
